TNPSC Exam Calendar 2026 @tnpsc.gov.in: The Tamil Nadu Public Service Commission conducts exams for various departments of the Tamil Nadu Government to recruit eligible candidates for various posts. To inform the candidates about the upcoming TNPSC exams, the commission releases the TNPSC Annual Planner. It contains the dates for important exams and notification release for the upcoming recruitments.

The TNPSC Exam Calendar 2026 was released on 3rd December 2025. It lists the exam schedule for important recruitments like TNPSC Combined Technical Services, TNPSC Group 1, Group 2, Group 3, Group 4, etc. In this article, you can check the TNPSC Exam Calendar PDF 2026, steps to download, important dates, and other details here.
